image_pattern_summary: Verified good images for this MCAT fall into three visual patterns: (1) completed real office cabin interiors showing executive desks, leather chairs, glass partitions, and wooden storage — photographed from a room-corner perspective; (2) high-quality 3D design renders of executive or corporate cabins featuring feature walls, marble flooring, and designer furniture; and (3) installed partition systems (glass-aluminium or wooden panel) showing the structural cabin framework in an office or industrial setting.

reason: Office cabin designing is a service category where the image communicates the design style, material quality, and spatial outcome — all of which are visually readable and buyer-relevant.
3D renders and completed project photos both carry design intent information (material finish, layout, lighting) that a buyer evaluates visually before enquiring.
Partition system photos show structural specifications (frame type, glass opacity, panel configuration) that are visually extractable and inform buyer decisions.
